title: Uncontrolled resource allocation in Kibana exception-list filter creation can lead to denial of… (CVE-2026-133857)
description: CVE-2026-133857 is a vulnerability in Kibana where an authenticated user with access to the Security solution can cause a denial of service by submitting a request with many exception-list identifiers. This triggers uncontrolled resource allocation, leading to memory exhaustion and crashing the Kibana process.
